lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to write His words in a book and promises to restore Israel and Judah from captivity.
The LORD will break the yoke off Jacob's people, and they will serve Him and Solomon their king.
The LORD will save Jacob from a distant place, not destroy him completely, yet discipline him justly.
The LORD will heal Zion, the city will be rebuilt on her ruins, and thanksgiving will come from them.
Their leader will come from Babylon, and the LORD will be their God and they will be His people.
